A '''Wookiee mercenary''' served as a member of the group known as [[Aurodium Sword/Legends|Aurodium Sword Executive Security]] at some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. On one assignment, the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] joined a rogue [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] known as [[Muzzle/Legends|Muzzle]] and fellow [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Snoova]] to protect a [[Unidentified Sullustan executive|Sullustan executive]]. When their client came under fire from an industrial [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]], the Wookiee mercenary came to his defense in the [[Unidentified Aurodium Sword skirmish|ensuing skirmish]]. An image of the battle reached the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] via an undercover [[Unidentified Imperial intelligence agent|Imperial intelligence agent]].

==Biography==
While operating as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] worked for the security firm known as [[Aurodium Sword/Legends|Aurodium Sword Executive Security]], an organization that protected wealthy clients from those who might try to harm them. In that position, the Wookiee worked alongside a free-agent [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] known as [[Muzzle/Legends|Muzzle]] and another Wookiee, a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Snoova]]. Some [[Time/Legends|time]] before [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a [[Unidentified Sullustan executive|Sullustan executive]] hired Aurodium Sword's services. When an industrial [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] found the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] and [[Unidentified Aurodium Sword skirmish|opened fire]], the Wookiee mercenary, Muzzle, and Snoova came to their charge's aid.<ref name="UAGoSaV" />

An image of the altercation reached an [[Unidentified Imperial intelligence agent|Imperial intelligence agent]], who sent it along with a report on Aurodium Sword to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Maximillian Seerdon]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] placed both the report and the image in a dossier on underworld figures he compiled shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The report made no mention of the Wookiee's name or that of the agent who had sent the image of the mercenary skirmish.<ref name="UAGoSaV" />

==Personality and traits==
During the altercation with the assassination squad, the Wookiee fought using a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. The mercenary had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], skin, and fur; the Wookiee's hair was tied with silver bands into three knots about the chin.<ref name="UAGoSaV" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Max had a clone commander and about three Wookiee action figures. They used to pal around together all the time, taking on all manner of foes-mostly in completely non-canon situations. (Fighting Darth Vader and his friend, Padawan Obi-Wan for example.)|Ryan Kaufman, on the inspiration for Aurodium Sword's Wookiee members|<ref name="Blog" />}}
A Wookiee member of Aurodium Sword appears in an illustration by [[Joe Corroney]] printed as part of "[[Underworld: A Galaxy of Scum and Villainy]]." The article, written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]], was published as part of [[Star Wars Insider 89|''Star Wars Insider'' 89]] in [[August]] [[2006]]. The text does not mention the character by name, nor does it provide the mercenary's [[Gender/Legends|gender]].<ref name="UAGoSaV" /> The idea for the character came from Ryan Kaufman's five-year-old son, Max, who liked to team up a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] action figure with three toy Wookiees. Kaufman found the idea of a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] backed up by Wookiees to be attractive, so he adopted that configuration for the Aurodium Sword organization.<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|42|Insider 89 "Underworld: A Galaxy of Scum & Villainy" Endnotes}}</ref>
